title: vernonia longicuspis
intro: Vernonia longicuspis, commonly known as the Long-spurred Ironweed, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia longicuspis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer activities, and have potential anti-diabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of Vernonia longicuspis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
